question: Town A is to the east of Town B. Town C is to the south of Town A. Town D is to the east of Town C. Town E is to the south of Town D. Town F is to the east of Town E. What is the position of Town F with respect to Town A?
solution:
• Town A is to the east of Town B.
 
• Town C is to the south of Town A.
 
• Town D is to the east of Town C.
 
• Town E is to the south of Town D.
 
• own F is to the east of Town E
